There was one other Fanatic related thing revealed at the UK Games Day.

In a Vengeance game, Christopher played Fanatic, using a page from his notebook as the character card. This Fanatic was called PW Fanatic.

She had 32 hit points, as far as I can remember, and a power, whose name I've forgotten if Christopher revealed it, that deals herself 3 radiant damage and allows a hero to use a power now.

Sadly PW did not stand for Paul Watson (and why not? Surely I am awesome enough to warrant such a tribute. ;-) ).
